site.title: Speechless | Student, Developer & Product Builder
site.description: Portfolio of Bosuakpe Michael Edem (Speechless), a Robotics Engineering and AI student at UMaT, Ghana, building software, AI projects, and products.

hero.headline: Learning. Building. Turning Ideas Into Products.
hero.copy: I'm Speechless, a Robotics Engineering and AI student exploring software development, artificial intelligence, and product building. I enjoy turning ideas into practical solutions and documenting what I learn along the way.

paragraphs: I'm a Robotics Engineering and Artificial Intelligence student at the University of Mines and Technology (UMaT), Ghana, developing my skills in programming, AI, robotics, and product development.
I learn best by building: picking a real problem, experimenting with a solution, and shipping something people can actually use.
Longer term, I want to become a capable technology builder who can design, develop, launch, and grow useful software products.

values.title: Curiosity
values.text: I like understanding how things work before I build on them.

values.title: Continuous learning
values.text: Every project is also a chance to pick up a new skill.

values.title: Practical experimentation
values.text: I try ideas in code early, then refine what works.

values.title: Problem-solving
values.text: I start from a real problem and work toward something useful.

values.title: Building and shipping
values.text: Finished and imperfect beats perfect and unseen.

values.title: Entrepreneurial thinking
values.text: I think about the people who would use what I build.

projects.name: School Drop
projects.description: A school-focused social platform built around school-specific access codes and anonymous student posts.

projects.name: Shelf Life
projects.description: An application concept that helps people keep track of product expiry dates and get reminded before things expire.
features: Expiry-date extraction from product images (intended workflow)

projects.name: Speechless Data Hub
projects.description: A data-reselling business with an online customer entry point. It's my hands-on way of learning digital entrepreneurship, customer experience, and online sales.

projects.name: Experiments and Future Builds
projects.description: Smaller coding experiments, plus future robotics and AI projects I'm planning to explore.

contact.intro: I'm open to internships, collaborations, and conversations about building useful products. If that sounds like your kind of project, I'd like to hear from you.

footer.closing: Still learning, still building. Thanks for stopping by.
